llm.summary: This is a simple local countdown/anniversary utility that stores user-entered dates on the machine and shows no evidence of hidden network, credential, or destructive behavior.

dimensions.detail: The artifacts match the stated purpose: a Chinese countdown/date calculator implemented as a Python CLI for adding, listing, editing, deleting, and calculating dates.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are explicit user-invoked commands; there are no role changes, prompt overrides, hidden agent instructions, or automatic execution directives.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The skill consists of SKILL.md and one Python script with no declared dependencies or package installation behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The script reads and writes a local JSON file at ~/.qclaw/workspace/countdown.json, which is disclosed and proportionate for storing countdown records.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Persistence is limited to the local countdown data file and only changes through user-directed add, edit, or delete commands; there is no background process, privilege escalation, or broad file access.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that event names, dates, tags, and notes are stored locally in ~/.qclaw/workspace/countdown.json. Avoid putting secrets in countdown notes, and be aware the documentation includes promotional website links, though the script itself does not make network calls.
llm.findings:
[SkillSpector] expected: SkillSpector reported no issues, which is consistent with the reviewed artifact behavior.
[VirusTotal] expected: VirusTotal telemetry was clean with no malicious or suspicious detections; this supports but does not determine the benign verdict.
[StaticScan] expected: Static scan reported no suspicious patterns, and manual review found only local file I/O for the disclosed countdown data file.
